lrk_inherited_review.interpretation: Inherited original 9 PASS / 2 FAIL, unchanged and not reclassified
findings: The original and IR model have identical physical interfaces, magnetization and winding amp-turns.
The effective material conversion has no measurable effect in the two disputed cases.
Including rotor-pocket air in weighted-stress torque selection was incorrect relative to the original model; the private adapter was corrected.
An otherwise equivalent rigid rotation changes low torques more than the allowed error, demonstrating mesh-orientation sensitivity.
The sliding-band no-load torque is 0.007491 mNm versus the fixed remeshed reference of 0.064900 mNm.
